item.title: Belgium’s prosecution of circumcision is antisemitic, Jewish leaders say
item.description: Jewish leaders said that prosecuting mohels was “antisemitic in nature, reminiscent of efforts taken in Europe against Jewish practice prior to the Second World War.”
